svg.text: CypherMonkey · Webex Lab · not a vendor document
Registers, no audio — SRTP path and UDP ports. Not a SIP 200 problem.
No registration — NAT source-port preservation, SIP ALG, or DNS.
933 fails, calls work — TCP 443 to both RedSky hosts.
One department only — Location PSTN connection and dial plan, not a global outage.
Contact center idle — Agent state, team, and queue skill. Not the Calling trunk.
